title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code v2.1.304–2.1.305: auto-mode setup, Managed Agents security check, fork subagents on by default
bullets.summary: Claude Code shipped 2.1.304 (Oct 19) and 2.1.305 (Oct 20) adding /auto-mode-setup, /claude-api managed-agents-secure (audits a Managed Agents config against Anthropic's security guide), unattended-retry watchdog env vars, a fix for worktree exit losing commits on detached HEAD, and gateway-compat retries; fork subagents became default in 2.1.302. Source is a changelog mirror quoting the official release notes.
bullets.how: The Construct: upgrade Mac runners to 2.1.305 for the worktree-loss fix and retry watchdog on unattended runs; run managed-agents-secure on any Managed Agents setups. PRAGMA: concrete guardrail talking points for client agent deployments. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Notion ships 6th-gen agent harness: 24h+ tasks, 'Auto' model router, BYOK
bullets.summary: Notion's rebuilt Agents can run single tasks for more than 24 hours (up from five minutes), route work to cost-appropriate models via an Auto router, and offer a two-tier credit system plus enterprise bring-your-own-key.
bullets.how: The Construct: validates the long-running-agent plus cost-tiered router pattern; compare against our own runner routing. PRAGMA: reference case for client conversations on agent cost control. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Mistral Voxtral 3 voice family and ElevenLabs Eleven Realtime launch
bullets.summary: Mistral released Voxtral 3 (speech recognition + TTS, 50+ languages, voice-agent SDK, API or on-prem) and ElevenLabs released Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models (Mini/Max, ~0.5s start of speech, 90+ languages); both per The Neuron's digest linking vendor posts on X, not independently verified.
bullets.how: The Construct: candidate voice layer for agents after a latency/quality eval. PRAGMA: voice-agent options for client phone/intake use cases. Brand 9 Signs: maybe, for quote-intake call handling later.

bullets.title: Agent governance is becoming a product category: Microsoft agent controls, WorkOS agent-to-agent SSO
bullets.summary: Microsoft is building controls to monitor or restrict enterprise agents, and WorkOS published an explainer on agent-to-agent SSO gaps (identity, delegation chains, auditability), following Okta's Agent SSO push.
bullets.how: The Construct: informs how runners authenticate and log delegation between agents. PRAGMA: strong consulting angle (agent identity and audit trails for operators). Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: OpenAI adds 12-hour prompt caching in the API; Perplexity Computer runs locally on Mac
bullets.summary: OpenAI says shared context can stay cached up to 12 hours, and Perplexity says its agent runs on Apple-silicon Macs with local files and native apps (both vendor posts on X relayed by The Neuron).
bullets.how: The Construct: long-lived caching could cut cost for repeated-context agent runs; Perplexity local agent is a competitor reference for our Mac-runner model. PRAGMA: cost and local-agent comparison material. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent value is shifting from raw model capability to the harness around it (long-running tasks, cost routers, identity and audit controls), so invest in runner guardrails, retries and logging before chasing the next model.
